name: Northeast Group Berhad
overview: 今年公司没有发布涉及业务扩张、新业务、缩减或出售的公告，公告主要为季度业绩、股东大会及委员会人事变动。最新一季（2026-06-30）营收同比增长35.3%，净利润同比增长38.8%。
overview_en: There were no announcements this year regarding business expansion, new businesses, downsizing, or divestments; announcements mainly covered quarterly results, general meetings, and committee changes. Latest quarter (2026-06-30) revenue grew 35.3% YoY and net profit grew 38.8% YoY.
